description: Off-tick advisory evaluator for Project Aegis requirement completeness in Linear and Notion backlogs. Script-first: deterministic mechanical pre-checks run first and Jev never overrides a failed mechanical gate.

thresholds.noul_note: Noul probability is the uncertainty (no separate confidence field). Pass requires noul >= 0.80.
thresholds.choice_note: Choice confidence < 0.50 or choice='other' triggers needs_human_review=true and blocks auto-complete.
thresholds.score_note: Use Score (0/1/2) for rank/threshold only; 0=missing, 1=incomplete, 2=complete. Require >= 1.50 for complete.

linear_presence_and_traceability.instructions: Does the Linear record—or verified-shipped trunk code/test/merged-Done exemption (sub_status=shipped_verified per M1 complete_if_code_verified_no_backfill, no Backlog ticket backfill required)—establish accurate presence and traceability (valid repo source_file, req_id cited on open Backlog including multi-requirement clause-cluster bundles covering this req_id, or shipped_verified evidence present, no OPEN-CRM-CPQ bleed, no contradiction with main)?

criteria.true: Linear record (including valid multi-requirement clause-cluster bundles with a targeted section for this req_id) or verified-shipped exemption (shipped_verified with trunk evidence or merged Done issue, no Backlog ticket required) accurately traces to the source requirement.
criteria.false: Linear match is absent, points to wrong requirement/project, or cites invalid paths.

linear_ac_and_scope_completeness.instructions: Does Linear coverage satisfy backlog intake completeness (valid source and req_id, testable AC or [Phase N]/Draft marker, honest lifecycle/blocker status, NO Surface: line/label on Backlog/Todo, no fake Done, Notion cross-link — including multi-requirement clause-cluster issues with a targeted AC section for this req_id), OR is this requirement exempt as shipped_verified (verified trunk code/test evidence or merged Done DRG-* issue)?

criteria.true: Linear coverage satisfies all contract and lifecycle honesty criteria (including multi-req clause-cluster issues with a targeted AC section), or requirement is exempt as shipped_verified with verified trunk/Done evidence.
criteria.false: Not exempt as shipped_verified and missing testable AC, Draft/Phase N marker, or Notion link, or has premature Done or unauthorized Surface: line/label on Backlog/Todo.

linear_completeness_score.instructions: Score the Linear backlog coverage quality for this requirement on the Project Aegis 0/1/2 scale.
criteria: missing — no Linear match and not exempt as shipped_verified
incomplete — Linear match exists but lacks source citation, testable AC, lifecycle/deferral honesty, or Notion cross-link, or has Surface: violation
complete — satisfies all contract, AC/deferral, cross-link, and lifecycle honesty criteria (including valid clause-cluster bundles) or shipped_verified exemption

linear_classification.instructions: Classify the requirement's Linear backlog tracking status given deterministic_checks, matched issues, and M1 Jev-calibrated scope rules (an open Backlog/In-Progress/In-Review/Todo issue with valid source/req_id, testable AC or [Phase N]/Draft marker, Notion link, no Surface: on Backlog/Todo, and honest status is 'complete' even if unstarted/Draft/Deferred or in a multi-req clause-cluster issue).

criteria.complete: P_LIN_CONTRACT=true (cites source/req_id, testable AC or [Phase N]/Draft marker, no Surface: on Backlog/Todo, Notion link, honest status — including multi-req clause-cluster issues) OR shipped_verified_exempt=true.
criteria.incomplete: Linear issue exists, not shipped_verified_exempt, and fails P_LIN_CONTRACT/P_ISO/P_SRC (missing source/req_id, AC, Notion link, dishonest status, or Surface: on Backlog/Todo).
criteria.missing: No matching Linear issue exists (P_LIN_EXISTS=false) and requirement is not shipped_verified_exempt.
criteria.other: Ambiguous or conflicting evidence preventing clean classification (valid tracked Draft, [Phase N] Deferred, multi-req cluster bundles, or properly labeled hold:owner-go items with complete contract use 'complete').

notion_presence_and_traceability.instructions: Does the M1-ratified active Notion surface (Tasks DB with Project=Project Aegis and/or cmano-clone wiki including Shipped Baseline & Requirements drafts, excluding read-only Frozen Git mirror) contain an entry (including multi-requirement clause-cluster entries) accurately tracing to this requirement (source_file, req_id, and Linear DRG-* link or shipped_verified note)?

criteria.true: Active Notion surface (Tasks DB or cmano-clone wiki, including multi-requirement clause-cluster entries for this req_id) accurately traces to source_file, req_id, and Linear DRG-* link or shipped_verified evidence.
criteria.false: No active-surface Notion entry (or only in Frozen Git mirror), or traceability links/project relation are missing or wrong.

notion_completeness_and_honesty.instructions: Does the Notion entry satisfy active-surface hygiene and honesty (if Tasks DB: non-null icon, Project=Project Aegis, Status=Blocked when blocked [Not started, In progress, and Done are valid—including Not started or In progress for open Backlog/Todo/In-Review/Partial+/Draft/[Phase N] items], and AC/deferral/shipped summary in Note or page content; accurate Draft/Phase N/active/shipped_verified framing; no premature Done before Linear unless shipped_verified; Frozen Git mirror untouched)?

criteria.true: Active Notion entry has required icon/Project (if Tasks DB), AC or deferral/shipped summary (or Shipped Baseline table) in Note or page content, and honest lifecycle/Status framing (Not started or In progress is valid for open Backlog/Todo/In-Review/Partial+/Draft/[Phase N] items; Done/Shipped valid when Linear Done or shipped_verified).
criteria.false: Notion entry lacks required icon/Project/metadata/AC summary (in Note and page content) or misstates Draft/Phase N/Blocked/Done status.

notion_completeness_score.instructions: Score the Notion backlog coverage quality for this requirement on the Project Aegis 0/1/2 scale.
criteria: missing — no entry on the active Notion surface (Tasks DB or cmano-clone wiki)
incomplete — active Notion entry exists but lacks Linear cross-link (or shipped_verified summary for shipped_verified_exempt), source citation, icon/Project, or honest lifecycle framing
complete — satisfies all active Notion surface schema, cross-link or shipped_verified summary, and honesty criteria

notion_classification.instructions: Classify the requirement's Notion backlog tracking status given deterministic_checks, matched Notion records, and M1 Jev-calibrated scope rules (an active Tasks DB/wiki entry with valid icon, Project=Project Aegis, source/req_id, Linear link, AC/deferral/shipped summary, and honest status is 'complete' even if unstarted/Draft/Deferred).

criteria.complete: P_NOT_CONTRACT=true on active surface (Tasks DB with Project=Project Aegis, icon, source/req_id, Linear link or shipped_verified, AC/deferral/shipped summary, honest Draft/Phase N/active/shipped status).
criteria.incomplete: Active Notion entry exists but fails P_NOT_CONTRACT/P_ISO/P_SRC (missing icon/Project, source/req_id, Linear link, AC/deferral summary, or dishonest Draft/Phase N/Done status).
criteria.missing: No entry exists on the active Notion surface (P_NOT_EXISTS=false; Frozen Git mirror does not count).
criteria.other: Ambiguous or conflicting evidence preventing clean classification (valid tracked Draft, [Phase N] Deferred, or properly labeled hold:owner-go items with complete contract use 'complete').

recommended_remediation.instructions: What backlog-tracker remediation is needed if Linear or Notion tracking itself is missing or fails contract? (Valid open Backlog/In-Progress/In-Review/Draft/Phase N tracking with complete links and AC requires 'none', NOT 'both'.)

criteria.none: Tracker coverage is complete (P_LIN_CONTRACT or shipped_verified_exempt AND P_NOT_CONTRACT pass, including valid open Backlog/In-Progress/In-Review/Draft/Phase N items); no tracker mutation needed.
criteria.create_linear: Linear tracking is missing (P_LIN_EXISTS=false and not shipped_verified_exempt); create Backlog issue only.
criteria.update_linear: Linear issue exists but fails contract/traceability (P_LIN_CONTRACT=false); update Linear only.
criteria.create_notion: Active Notion entry is missing (P_NOT_EXISTS=false); create Tasks/wiki entry only.
criteria.update_notion: Active Notion entry exists but fails contract/metadata/AC summary (P_NOT_CONTRACT=false); update Notion only.
criteria.both: Both Linear and active Notion tracking are missing or fail contract (P_LIN_CONTRACT=false and P_NOT_CONTRACT=false).
criteria.other: Ambiguous contradiction requiring human owner decision (never use for properly tracked Draft, [Phase N] Deferred, or hold:owner-go items, which use 'none').
